title: Numerically stable softmax
prompt: Implement `softmax(logits)` returning a probability list that sums to 1. Use max-subtraction for stability. Stdlib math.
public_tests_hint:
- sums to 1
- argmax preserved
- handles large logits
test_source:
import math
import solution

def run():
    p=solution.softmax([1.0,2.0,3.0])
    assert abs(sum(p)-1)<1e-9
    assert p.index(max(p))==2
    p2=solution.softmax([1000.0,1000.0,1000.0])
    assert all(math.isfinite(x) for x in p2) and abs(sum(p2)-1)<1e-9
